pretreatments.description: Mechanical degradation of kitchen waste using a cutter to produce particulates and a home-type coffee grinder to achieve fine particles smaller than 4 mm.
Dilution of cow manure and grinded kitchen waste with tap water until concentrations reached near the municipal waste concentration (1024 kg/m^3).
Anaerobic stabilization in 1.8 L vessels by injecting N2 99% for 5 minutes and maintaining for 5 days.
Chemical pretreatment using Sodium Hydroxide (NaOH) in ranges of 0–4% of total weight.
Chemical pretreatment using Hydrogen Peroxide (H2O2) in ranges of 0–4% of total weight.
